evidence.quote: enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The assertion enacts authority-ranking: saving a memory automatically assigns the creator a reviewer role — a rank-based allocation performed by the system, not a reciprocal exchange or pooled identity.

mints.name: RoleAssignmentBySystemAction
mints.title: enrolls its creator as a reviewer
